name: Real Transient Partly Masked By A Failed Channel
description: A pressurizer level channel fails high at the same time a pressurizer relief valve sticks open. The real inventory loss is under way, but one indication looks reassuring. The operator must not be lulled by the optimistic channel.
briefing: At t+20 s a pressurizer level channel fails high. At t+30 s a relief valve sticks 25% open. The plant is really losing inventory. Trust the voted value and the physical symptoms (pressure, sub-cooling).
learning_objectives: Coincident instrument + process faults are the hardest to diagnose
Never dismiss a transient on the strength of one favourable indication
Using multiple independent parameters to confirm primary inventory status

events.label: Pressurizer level channel B failed high
